sample_audit.name: HubSpot
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 & Pass 2 missed HubSpot's GraphQL API and public OpenAPI catalog (left REST-only & OpenAPI=Unknown). Human audit corrected to REST + GraphQL and OpenAPI=Yes (all auth/MCP/verdict fields were already right).

sample_audit.name: DealCloud
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed live in browser (HTTP 200): Official Intapp DealCloud MCP requires Celeste license, and custom/third-party AI clients explicitly require 'Contact your Account Manager'.

sample_audit.name: Help Scout
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 wrongly marked 'Ready Today' despite Free plan excluding API access. Pass 2 automatically caught the contradiction and corrected verdict to 'Buildable with Friction'.

sample_audit.name: Gladly
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed via live Composio github toolkit: gladly/claude-plugin is owned by the official 'gladly' Organization (Apache-2.0, active Nov 2026), and REST API requires customer admin account.

sample_audit.name: Discord
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed: Free self-serve Bot Token + OAuth2, OpenAPI spec published, webhooks/Gateway events supported, Community MCP only (no official Discord MCP).

sample_audit.name: WhatsApp Business
sample_audit.verification_method: Exa Indexed Crawl + Composio Catalog (Browser DNS blocked)
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed Embedded Signup / Meta Business Verification gating and System User Bearer auth. Honest caveat: developers.facebook.com hit DNS resolution failure in our browser sandbox, so verified via Exa crawl + live Composio whatsapp catalog.

sample_audit.name: Google Ads
sample_audit.verification_method: Pass 2 HTTP Link Audit + Official Docs
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 cited a dead support URL (adspolicy/answer/6169371). Pass 2 link checker caught it and replaced it with live Google Ads OAuth & developer-token access-level docs.

sample_audit.name: LinkedIn Ads
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed: OAuth2 with strict Marketing Developer Platform app review, no official MCP server found, correctly mapped to Composio's linkedin_ads slug (after human removed broad 'linkedin' alias).

sample_audit.name: Amazon Selling Partner
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed: LWA OAuth2 + mandatory Seller/Developer registration & review; official amzn/selling-partner-agentic-toolkit repo.

sample_audit.name: fanbasis
sample_audit.audit_finding: Browser audit confirmed FanBasis officially rebranded to Commas ('FanBasis is now Commas!'), commas-cli really is their MCP CLI, and official API/SDK/MCP docs live at commasdocs.com. Upgraded primary evidence link to commasdocs.com.

sample_audit.name: Sherlock
sample_audit.audit_finding: Both Pass 1 & Pass 2 misclassified a third-party Apify Actor URL as 'Community MCP Only'. Human audit fixed mcp_status -> None Found while confirming local CLI / 116k-star MIT repo via Composio GitHub & DeepWiki.

sample_audit.name: Clay
sample_audit.audit_finding: Major browser catch: Pass 1 & Pass 2 claimed broad REST + OpenAPI=Yes + Ready Today. Live browser audit proved /docs/http-api and /docs/webhooks 404 — Clay has no general public REST API; its programmatic surface is Official MCP (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + open DCR at api.clay.com/v3/mcp) + narrow table lookup keys. Fixed to MCP Only, OpenAPI=No, Buildable with Friction.

sample_audit.name: GitHub
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 listed REST only (missing GitHub's GraphQL v4 API). Pass 2 caught and corrected api_protocol to REST + GraphQL.

sample_audit.name: Snowflake
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed: Account-scoped JWT/OAuth2/PAT auth, Cortex Agents official MCP, customer account & warehouse provisioning friction.

sample_audit.name: Notion
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 left webhooks_supported=Unknown. Pass 2 resolved it to Yes using Notion's official docs corroborated by 8 live triggers in Composio's catalog.

sample_audit.name: Linear
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 falsely marked openapi_spec_available=Yes on a GraphQL-only API. Pass 2 verified Linear's docs and corrected OpenAPI -> No.

sample_audit.name: Paygent Connect
sample_audit.verification_method: Human Web & Primary Docs Audit (NMI / Paygent)
sample_audit.audit_finding: Biggest agent failure: Both Pass 1 & Pass 2 confused Paygent Connect (NMI-powered payment gateway) with 'Payman AI' (paymanai.mintlify.app/mcp-server). Human audit completely replaced the misattributed record with NMI/Paygent's real security_key / partner-gated merchant API and mcp_status=None Found.

sample_audit.name: iPayX
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed live in browser (HTTP 200): FINTRAC-registered FX audit platform, self-serve Free/$99/$299 tiers, Bearer token (ipx_live_*), and an official 3-tool MCP server.

sample_audit.name: Otter AI
sample_audit.audit_finding: Confirmed live in browser: Official hosted MCP (mcp.otter.ai/mcp) uses OAuth with 3 read-only tools (Get user info, Search, Fetch) and no public API key, while the full REST API remains Enterprise-gated.

sample_audit.name: Mermaid CLI
sample_audit.audit_finding: Pass 1 attributed commercial Mermaid Chart SaaS MCP (mermaid.ai) to the open-source mermaid-cli binary. Pass 2 caught the product split and corrected mcp_status -> None Found.
